names.note: Read out of the title on his name page, «Димитрий (Овечкин), иерей, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off. The day's line declines the forename and gives no surname: «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мц. Елисаветы (1937).»

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 1 ноября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page for him and his name page holds two days and no text.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мц. Елисаветы (1937).»

attestations.note: The line's «Сщмч.» is hieromartyr and its «пресвитеров» presbyter; his name page's «иерей» is the grade and goes in `office` as Priest. The surname «Овечкин» returns no other folder in the corpus.
